Roll-up of Surface and turf_spec that creates the most relevant categories for our analysis of manufacturers and, where necessary, splitting manufacturers into slit-film and other products; this is one of two primary surface variables used in our analysis.

Roll-up of Surface_detailed that uses three categories: natural grass, artificial slit-film, and other artificial turfs; hybrid surfaces are marked as NA; this is one of two primary surface variables used in our analysis
Roll-up of Surface_3 cat that combines both types of artificial turf into single category
